candidates.name: Chen2020 baseline
candidates.role: system baseline characterization: ED / mass / 5C retention reference point; no parameter overrides

llm_reason: Round 1 = baseline + opening ceiling assessment (protocol Stage 3 opening). Task names no electrode system -> Chen2020 per anchor table. Measure current ED (expect ~250-400 Wh/kg), mass (vs 40 g), and 5C retention (DFN; SPMe underestimates at 5C). Ceiling assessment will decide whether Stage 2 system escalation is required; prior domain reasoning suggests thin-inactive architecture can lift NMC811/graphite stack ED to ~450-500 Wh/kg and 5C is the binding constraint (solid diffusion), fixed via particle radius + electrolyte transport rather than chemistry switch.
